verdict: Meta is carrying all leads; Google spend needs immediate rebalancing.

Your Google Business Profile logged 126 actions this period, but activity appears to have paused in the most recent days — we're verifying the profile is healthy and data is reporting correctly. Expect the next period to reflect a leaner Google allocation and continued pressure on Meta to hold or improve the current cost per lead.
